purpose: Resolve, by explicit human product-owner authority, the three authority gaps discovered AFTER the formal seal of FIB_IMPLEMENTATION_BASELINE v1.0.0 during the independent Wave 1 implementation audit and its remediation specification. This addendum adds authority; it does not modify, reopen, or reinterpret any sealed artifact.

discovery_source.note: W1-05-RM1 re-adjudicated every W1-05 finding against the sealed baseline and isolated exactly two decisions the sealed text could not determine (HPO-DEC-1, HPO-DEC-2) plus one naming correspondence correction (HPO-DEC-3). No other architecture choice was found to be materially required before Wave 1 remediation.

decisions.title: Governance regime activation
decisions.resolves_gap: FIBDB-003 is titled 'projects and other governed objects' and never enumerates that set; FIBIU-01 declares 'lib/pipeline/** (regime stamping)' and the exit gate 'no new object is born without a regime', while FIBIU-30 independently declares DB_CHANGES 'FIBDB-042/003 (regime column and vocabulary)' in wave 6. The sealed text does not choose between the two readings.
authoritative_meaning: Wave 1 shall apply governance_regime to every object whose governance regime is activated by a Wave 1 authority.
For FIBIU-01 this includes, at minimum: projects; outcome_taxonomy_mappings.
Objects governed by later owning units acquire governance_regime when their owning authority becomes active.
FIBIU-30 closes global governed-object regime coverage.

The FIBIU-01 statement 'no new object is born without a regime' applies to objects whose governed regime is active at that stage; it does not force Wave 1 to prematurely add governance_regime to every object whose owning governance unit remains intentionally deferred.
consequence: Wave 1 remediation may create the additive migration required for outcome_taxonomy_mappings and any other object strictly and demonstrably owned by the active Wave 1 authority under this decision.
Wave 1 remediation MUST NOT opportunistically add governance_regime to all later-wave objects.

decisions.title: Indicator / stakeholder lifecycle DB identity
decisions.resolves_gap: FIBIU-03 carries the frozen DB_CHANGES list 'FIBDB-004' and simultaneously the exit gate 'indicators and stakeholder_groups gain lifecycle state and an archive path they lack today'. No FIBDB item in the 55-item registry names indicators or stakeholder_groups, so the physical form of that lifecycle state was left undetermined; sections 17.1 and 17.4 nevertheless assert DB_TARGET_COMPLETE and ZERO_MATERIALIZER_ARCHITECTURE_CHOICES_REMAINING. This addendum resolves that omission.
authoritative_meaning: For indicators and stakeholder_groups, current operational lifecycle state is explicitly persisted through status, archived_by and archived_at, including the corresponding constrained status vocabulary and referential integrity required by the already materialized implementation.
domain_object_versions remains the append-only governed historical lineage.
The version lineage does NOT replace the current operational lifecycle projection.
Archive operations preserve both responsibilities: (1) operational current-state projection; and (2) governed append-only historical lineage.
Historical evidence and previously emitted audit records MUST NOT be rewritten.
consequence: The sealed baseline omission identified in W1-05-RM1 is resolved by this HPO authority addendum.
No new frozen database identifier is created to number this decision.

decisions.title: Canonical SROI calculation audit action
decisions.resolves_gap: FIBC-001 names the audit verb 'sroi_run.calculated' while the Wave 1 implementation emits 'sroi_calculation_run.created', which matches neither the sealed literal nor the transition actually performed. FIBC-040 requires the verb to correspond to the object and the transition.
authoritative_meaning: The canonical governed audit action for a successfully calculated SROI calculation run is 'sroi_calculation_run.calculated', with entityType 'sroi_calculation_run'.
The earlier FIBC-001 literal 'sroi_run.calculated' is superseded ONLY as a naming/correspondence correction for this audit action.
The substantive requirement that a successful SROI calculation emits a governed calculation audit event remains unchanged.
Historical audit rows are immutable and MUST NOT be rewritten.
consequence: R-3 becomes UNGATED and is authorized to emit prospectively 'sroi_calculation_run.calculated'.
The verb/object correspondence invariant applies prospectively only.

scope_note: This addendum grants authority only. It implements nothing. The Wave 1 remediation set frozen by W1-05-RM1 (R-1 through R-7, plus G-1 and G-2, now ungated) remains unexecuted at the audited head recorded above, and Wave 1 stays formally OPEN until an independent re-audit of the remediated tree passes.
